title: World's 'Most Traveled People' Share Must-Visit Places
paragraphs: If you want to know the best places to visit, who should you ask? Perhaps the best people to ask are those who have visited every country in the world.

Most Traveled People, or MTP, is a website where travelers can record all the places they have visited. It was started by Charles Veley in 2005. Members who have visited every country can become "UN Grandmasters," but they must show proof, such as passport stamps or photos. So far, 122 people have become UN Grandmasters.
After a meeting of UN Grandmasters in Portugal, the news website Euronews asked some of them about their favorite places. The results were published in June 2026.

In Europe, Italy was the clear favorite. More than half of the travelers chose it as their top country. One of them said, "Italy has an amazing culture and cuisine that is decidedly different in each region." Italy was also chosen as the country with the best food in the world. France, Spain, Portugal and Greece came next.
Outside Europe, the favorite country was Iran. One traveler said Iran has "some of the warmest hospitality a traveller can experience." Japan was second, followed by Italy, China and Brazil.

The travelers also chose the most underrated countries, which are places that are better than people think. In Europe, Albania was first, followed closely by Romania. The most underrated city in Europe was Ljubljana, in Slovenia. Outside Europe, Iran was also chosen as the most underrated country, followed by Yemen and São Tomé and Príncipe.
The travelers also recommended some unusual places, such as Canaima National Park in Venezuela, the salt flats of Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia and Antarctica.
